entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JsonColumn with primitive collection in Select throws NullReference exception #39255
  • A cancelled connection open does not reach interceptors: the async path calls the sync ConnectionCanceled, and the composite interceptor forwards neither #39254
  • Vulnerable transitive System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs dependency introduced by Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer #39252
  • EF Core 11 regression: FromSql on an entity with a JSON complex property throws NullReferenceException in GenerateComplexJsonShaper #39251

Closed

  • NewExpression constructor translations (e.g. new DateTimeOffset) don't work in projections (Select) #38083
    12.0-preview1
  • Translate GroupBy followed by FirstOrDefault (and similar) using ROW_NUMBER() #36380
    12.0-preview1
  • GroupBy nullable column followed by First() over group returns null record #29240
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Specification.Tests 11.0 RC1 cannot be restored from NuGet.org because of non-public Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions dependency #38952
    11.0-rc2
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: the pool can hand one connection to two openers while it grows (race between Activate and ReclaimLeakedConnections) #39253
  • Precompiled queries code produces nullable annotation warning on build #37996
    12.0-preview1
  • GetRelationalModel throws "The model must be finalized" when two threads make the first call at once (check-then-act on RelationalModelFactory) #39214
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Update System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to 10.0.13 #39263
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Abstractions from 9.0.20 to 9.0.21 #39262
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.32 #39261
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39260
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39259
  • [release/8.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.32 #39258
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #39257
  • Remove SkipOnLinuxEmulator for projection order dependent tests #39256
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Fix TODATETIMEOFFSET translation in projection #39223
    community-contribution
  • Query: translate GroupBy element reads with ROW_NUMBER only #39173
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Restore LEFT JOIN translation for correlated grouped DefaultIfEmpty #39237
    Servicing-approved
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26509.3 to 11.0.0-beta.26509.113 #39246
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.12 to 2.0.13 #39247
    area-infrastructure
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #39249
  • Bump the npm group in /eng/harness-evaluation with 2 updates #39248
    area-infrastructure, area-harness
  • Enable nullable annotations in precompiled query interceptors #39224
    community-contribution
  • Don't apply optimized null expansion to the projection of an IN subquery #39232
    community-contribution
  • Return the starting position for IndexOf with an empty string on SQL Server #39231
    community-contribution
  • Read TimeOnly values stored as REAL in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39227
    community-contribution
  • Fix GetRelationalModel race condition #39216
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Make the evals more realistic and improve the skills accordingly #39217
    area-harness
  • Add AggregateFunctionExpression as a relational base for provider aggregate functions #39234
    community-contribution
  • Log FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning for First on a collection navigation in a subquery #39218
    community-contribution
  • Fix Concat on string in query #39221
    community-contribution
  • Cast to the closed ValueConverter<,> in the precompiled shaper #39236
    community-contribution
  • Fix Not on bool? and Increment/Decrement on non-int types in LinqToCS… #39230
    community-contribution
  • Keep fractional seconds in SQL Server TimeSpan literals #39229
    community-contribution
